title: The Spectre #4 DC Comics 2001 Hal Jordan DeMatteis Sook Superman Batman
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Spectre #4 (Jun 2001), DC Comics - the 2001 series with Hal Jordan as the Spectre. Written by J.M. DeMatteis, art and cover by Ryan Sook. "Doom of the Nameless Land!" cover with Superman and Batman. Original $2.50 cover price.

Back cover: Our Lady Peace Spiritual Machines ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
